name: Ospesjel
source:
Ospesjel is a short click-through story about the soul of a book making a five-year pact with a trickster spirit to turn her into a human. The five years are almost up, and as she slowly turns back into a novel, she returns to the spirit to beg it to keep her human by any means necessary.

[From [url=https://lesflaya.itch.io/ospesjel]Itch.io[/url]]
